name: PT Toba Surimi Industries Tbk
summary: PT Toba Surimi Industries Tbk is a prominent player in Indonesia's seafood processing industry. Its product portfolio encompasses a variety of pasteurized crab products, such as jumbo lump, super lump, special claw, and cocktail claw cuts. Beyond pasteurized offerings, the company also supplies an array of canned and frozen seafood, including fish, cephalopods, shellfish, and other value-added marine products. With a global reach, its exports serve key international markets including the United States, the European Community, Japan, Hong Kong, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia. Established in 1997, the company maintains its headquarters in Medan, Indonesia.
